sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
"OBJECTIVES: DEPLOY TO TARGET LOCATION
- LOCATE RAINBOW EGGS
- RETRIEVE RAINBOW EGGS
- ???
- PROFIT? (cArr0t?)"
— Cotton in A Colorful Hunt

Cotton is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. It is a robot created by Vikki to hunt for eggs.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: As an NPC character, Cotton first appears in the Festive Event, A Colorful Hunt.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
In A Colorful Hunt, Cotton enters in the world of Grand Gaia in search for rainbow eggs, only to find out that Carrol was gathering them already. Upon encountering Carrol, Cotton engages in a battle with her in attempt to steal the rainbow eggs, but is defeated by the hands of Carrol and her group.

Following Cotton's defeat, Cotton becomes saddened by its failed mission of not being able to "fulfill retrieval of rainbow eggs." Carrol then explains how being rude does not help it as she would have shared the rainbow eggs to Cotton if it had asked nicely. Much to Carrol's surprise, Cotton fails to understand what sharing is. Cotton is then fed with snacks and drinks in hopes of understanding what sharing is all about. To better understand a new perspective of life, Cotton gives itself new objectives: LeaRn "SHARING!", undErsTanD "ADVENTURE!", HavE "FUN!" Cotton concludes by promising to remain in Grand Gaia to collect rainbow eggs and carrots and aid Carrol in her adventures.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: As the lore suggests, Cotton is an oddly adorable creature. Cotton is relatively subjective in that it works towards objectives it's given. As mentioned by Carrol, Cotton has a funny way of talking, as it tends to output uppercase and lowercase letters in random sequences in the words of its dialogue.

sections.title: As a unit
sections.content: See Egg Seeking Cotton and Autonomous Cotton

sections.title: Carrol
sections.content: Upon encountering Carrol, Cotton acted rash towards her given the objective it was given, even attacking Carrol and her friends. Upon defeat, Cotton is taught how to ask for things in a polite manner rather than stealing. Carrol befriends and invites Cotton to her group to adventure off.

sections.title: Vikki
sections.content: Vikki is Cotton's creator. Cotton often refers to her as "mistress".
